correctness.rationale: The generator columns are (f(x),x) for x≠0 together with 32 duplicates from a·x=1. The dimension-seven message map is injective: restriction to mixed E1/E2 positions forces v=0, then f forces u=0. For every r, orthogonal annihilator W of dimension 7−r retains exactly the zero generator columns, so d_r=95−max_W multiplicity(W); each RREF subspace is unique. A fresh independent Python RREF census of all 29,211 nonzero subspaces for each of inside a=1 and outside a=9 reproduced all fourteen claimed d_r and multiplicities, including inside M2=7, M3=126. The orbit action of GL(3,2)×GL(3,2) and factor exchange is transitive on both normal types; this covers every stated code.
